connector.name: Eclipse Ditto
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the Eclipse Ditto digital twin HTTP API (things, policies, connections, more).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package eclipse-ditto-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nagarjunr account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DITTO_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Ditto HTTP API, e.g. http://localhost:8080

env.name: DITTO_USERNAME
env.description: Basic auth username for the Things/Policies/Messages/Search API

env.name: DITTO_PASSWORD
env.description: Basic auth password for the Things/Policies/Messages/Search API

env.name: DITTO_BEARER_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token, used instead of Basic auth for the same API

env.name: DITTO_DEVOPS_USERNAME
env.description: Basic auth username for the separate DevOps/Connections realm

env.name: DITTO_DEVOPS_PASSWORD
env.description: Basic auth password for the separate DevOps/Connections realm
